definitions.full: H2045. hashmauth הַשְׁמָעוּת noun feminine a causing to hear (properly Aramaizing Infinitive Hiph`il; Ges § 53l Sta § 304 a ); — ׳לְהַשׁ אָזֳנ֑יִם Ezek 24:26 to cause ears to hear , i.e. bring tidings in person (? read דָממ֫לַת +? ZMG 1viii (1903), 416 ).
